title: The explanatory existential query drops one successor from the goal.
details: Jean Gallier, corrected Dover2015 Logic for Computer Science, Example9.4.1, printed p414 (PDFp438, one-based). The initial goal is add(succ(0),V,succ(succ(0))), and the computed answer is V=succ(0). When rewriting the negation of that goal as an existential query, the source instead prints exists V add(succ(0),V,succ(0)). The last argument must remain succ(succ(0)). In the intended natural-number addition structure, the printed query asks for V=0, whereas the actual goal asks for V=1; hence the displayed goal transcription changes the requested computation. The preceding refutation and answer substitution match the corrected goal. The corpus adoption in `definite-horn-sld-resolution#addition-example` retains the corrected two-successor query.
